include(cc_library)

if(DEFINED BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
    set(_XLLM_SERVICE_HAS_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ON)
    set(_XLLM_SERVICE_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS "${BUILD_SHARED_LIBS}")
endif()
if(DEFINED BUILD_TESTS)
    set(_XLLM_SERVICE_HAS_BUILD_TESTS ON)
    set(_XLLM_SERVICE_BUILD_TESTS "${BUILD_TESTS}")
endif()
if(DEFINED BUILD_SAMPLES)
    set(_XLLM_SERVICE_HAS_BUILD_SAMPLES ON)
    set(_XLLM_SERVICE_BUILD_SAMPLES "${BUILD_SAMPLES}")
endif()
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "Build shared libraries" FORCE)
set(BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "Build tests" FORCE)
set(BUILD_SAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "Build samples" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(cpprestsdk)
if(DEFINED _XLLM_SERVICE_HAS_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
    set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS "${_XLLM_SERVICE_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS}" CACHE BOOL "Build shared libraries" FORCE)
else()
    unset(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS CACHE)
endif()
if(DEFINED _XLLM_SERVICE_HAS_BUILD_TESTS)
    set(BUILD_TESTS "${_XLLM_SERVICE_BUILD_TESTS}" CACHE BOOL "Build tests" FORCE)
else()
    unset(BUILD_TESTS CACHE)
endif()
if(DEFINED _XLLM_SERVICE_HAS_BUILD_SAMPLES)
    set(BUILD_SAMPLES "${_XLLM_SERVICE_BUILD_SAMPLES}" CACHE BOOL "Build samples" FORCE)
else()
    unset(BUILD_SAMPLES CACHE)
endif()
set(CPPREST_INCLUDE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cpprestsdk/Release/include)
set(CPPREST_LIB ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/third_party/cpprestsdk/Release/Binaries/libcpprest.a)
add_subdirectory(etcd_cpp_apiv3)
add_subdirectory(brpc)
add_subdirectory(minja)
add_subdirectory(sentencepiece)
add_subdirectory(smhasher/src)
add_subdirectory(xxHash)
